name: Loaded spinach, mushroom and sunflower seed plate
description: A very large soy-free vegan breakfast plate for a high calorie target: ten cups of spinach wilted into hard-seared mushrooms with warm cooked lentils, finished with sunflower seeds. Nothing here carries one of the nine tracked allergens, so it is the plate to reach for when nuts and sesame are out as well as soy.
instructions: Set two wide non-stick pans over high heat, divide the mushrooms between them in a single layer and leave them undisturbed for 4 minutes so they colour rather than steam.
Stir once, add the salt and the black pepper, and cook for 3 minutes more until both pans are dry.
Divide the lentils between the pans and warm them through for 2 minutes.
Fold in the spinach a large handful at a time and cook for 1 minute, just until it has all collapsed.
Spread everything over one large plate and scatter the sunflower seeds over the top.
